intro: Senir's Report is a dispatched document penned by Mountaineer Senir Whitebeard detailing the Frostmane troll threat in Dun Morogh. It carries findings commissioned under royal directive and is destined for Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge.

p: Drafted after scouting missions against the Frostmane trolls nestled in the crags of Dun Morogh, this field report contains mountaineer observations intended for the dwarf Senate. Senir Whitebeard, stationed out in the cold foothills, penned the document and enclosed his brother Grelin's report on Coldridge Valley, which states that Grelin acted under a sanction from King Magni Bronzebeard. Senir tasks adventurers with hauling the findings straight to Senator Barin Redstone in the High Seat of Ironforge—cautiously advising couriers to omit just how much outside help he required to compile it.
